name: How much does it cost to hire a delivery injury lawyer?
description: Most delivery injury lawyers work on a contingency fee basis, meaning you only pay if they win your case, typically a percentage of your settlement.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to hire a delivery injury lawyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most delivery injury lawyers work on a contingency fee basis. This means you typically do not pay any upfront fees or hourly rates. Instead, the lawyer's fees are a percentage of the compensation they successfully recover for you. If they don't win your case, you generally don't owe them attorney's fees. This arrangement makes legal representation accessible to those who might not otherwise be able to afford it. You should discuss the specific percentage and any potential litigation costs during your initial consultation.
